item.title: software dev intern @ thrive health
item.description: my first tEcH iNterNsHiP. throughout my time here, i got to work on parts of the canadian covid information app and contribute new frontend/ backend features to the company’s main health platform. overall, i learned a lot about web development and software engineering in the real world

item.title: cpsc ta @ ubc
item.description: remember those people that graded your assignments and exams in university? that's me! i've ta-ed a few second year computer science courses and had a great time helping students in whatever way i could. one term i built a vs code extension for one of our course’s custom toy-assembly language. check it out here!
